candidates.requirement: Make successful uncompress of supported zlib streams producing more than 65,025 bytes reachable.
candidates.target_route: The entry derives output capacity from data[0] times data[1], then calls uncompress once with the entire input.
candidates.failure_condition: A valid zlib stream containing two 32,768-byte stored blocks of zeroes produces 65,536 bytes. The harness allocates at most 255 × 255 = 65,025 bytes, so this supported call cannot complete successfully.
candidates.alternative_paths: The complete entry makes no second call or capacity adjustment; every input has the same 65,025-byte maximum.
